claim: Pasting the full leaked Fable prompt makes Sonnet equal to Fable.
reason: Prompt text cannot transfer model weights or provider-side capabilities.

claim: Replacing Claude Code's system prompt is better than appending.
reason: Replacement can remove native tool, environment, permission, and safety scaffolding.

claim: Starting on Fable then switching to Sonnet preserves Fable intelligence.
reason: Visible artifacts persist; hidden inference and model weights do not. The model switch also warms a separate cache.

claim: A giant prompt always improves quality.
reason: Large repeated instructions can reduce adherence and trigger unnecessary reasoning.

claim: Separate fresh-context roles can improve review.
reason: Independent contexts reduce self-critique contamination and are recommended in Fable guidance.

claim: All work should use max effort.
reason: Effort should be tied to remaining judgment; deterministic work gains nothing from extra reasoning.
Every configured role uses model: sonnet; no other API is called.
